evidence_boundary: This per-task spec defines execution contracts only. It does not contain task outputs, scores, or downstream success evidence.

input_contract.original_style_input: Small single-cell accessibility or multi-omics dataset, analysis objective, and resource budget.

output_contract.required_output: Runnable analysis pipeline with embedding or clustering output plus runtime and memory log.

metric_contract.name: runtime_memory_quality
metric_contract.success_criterion: Pipeline completes under the declared budget and produces expected embedding or clustering artifacts.
metric_contract.source_metric_relation: Matches SnapATAC2-style scalable single-cell analysis, adapted to a small local dataset.
metric_contract.metric_source_policy: Use the original task metric family where practical; document any local proxy.

reference_score_policy.label: SnapATAC2 reported runtime/memory or analysis reference
reference_score_policy.policy: Treat original paper scores as reported references unless the same dataset, input/output, metric, model/tool budget, and runtime setting are reproduced locally.

run_controls.random_seed_policy: record seed when the task harness uses randomness

workflow_checklist: Load data with the declared preprocessing assumptions.
Run the selected SnapATAC2-style analysis path.
unsupported_error_policy: Count invented method claims that are not supported by the source paper or task fixture.
Count steps that contradict the declared input, output, metric, or run budget.
Count claims of completed results that are not present in the raw output log.
next_action: Create or select the fixture manifest and implement runner/scorer support before execution.
